title: Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate
question:
Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate the play format and the names of all the card meet the condition.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: play format refers to format; banned status refers to status = 'Banned'; the highest number of banned status refers to MAX(COUNT(status = 'Banned'))

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
    c.XCL_003 AS play_format,
    c.XCL_002 AS card_name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
WHERE l.XCL_085 = 'Banned'
ORDER BY
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM cards c2
        JOIN legalities l2 ON c2.XCL_072 = l2.XCL_086
        WHERE l2.XCL_085 = 'Banned'
          AND c2.XCL_003 = c.XCL_003
    ) DESC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.XCL_003)
FROM legalities l
JOIN cards c ON l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072
WHERE l.XCL_085 = 'Banned'
  AND l.XCL_084 = (
    SELECT XCL_084
    FROM legalities
    WHERE XCL_085 = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY XCL_084
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  );
